newsitem.title: USA: Albright to visit Malaysia, Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Albright to visit Malaysia, Singapore.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright will visit Malaysia and Singapore in the last week of July, the State Department announced on Wednesday.
In Kuala Lumpur, Albright will attend a regional forum following the July 24-25 annual foreign ministers' meeting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), spokesman Nicholas Burns said.

ASEAN groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam, but the forum on political and security issues will be attended by foreign ministers of 20 countries, including China, Russia and Japan as well as the United States.
Albright will later have talks with ASEAN about U.S. relations with the grouping.
After spending July 26-29 in the Malaysian capital, Albright will visit Singapore until July 30, Burns said. Her talks there will cover trade, regional and human rights issues, he said.
Human rights have been a source of friction between the United States and Singapore, which has been criticised in an annual State Department report for undemocratic practices.
